prompts.module-boiler:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied game equipment icon into a flat, cute hand-drawn 2D illustration. It is an OBJECT, not a living character. Remove absolutely all eyes, mouth, eyebrows, cheeks, teeth, hands, arms, shoes and feet. Preserve the recognizable idea: a comically squat round coral pressure boiler, slightly crooked oversized lid, a single oversized cream pressure gauge, two simple utility handles, and a small curled puff of steam. Keep its warm coral, cream, mustard and deep teal palette.
Art direction: charming contemporary illustrated board-game token, playful handmade paper-cut / gouache sticker style. Bouncy slightly asymmetrical silhouette, a confident gently irregular dark-teal outline, broad matte color fills, only ONE small hard-edged accent shadow shape, very subtle sparse paper grain. Front-facing simplified drawing, virtually no perspective. Charming proportions and shape design, never facial expression. No smooth gradients, no bevels, no rendered 3D, no clay, no photo texture, no reflections, no realistic lighting, no realistic materials. No stock office clip-art. The boiler belly has a simple small cream four-point spark decal, not facial marks. Make the circular gauge clearly functional, not an eye: three scale ticks and one orange needle.
Exactly one complete isolated icon centered in a square, fills 84% canvas with even transparent margin. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow, no scene, no text, no frame, no white sticker border. Bold shapes readable at 40px.
